info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Trade Confirmation Matching API
info.description: The Trade Confirmation Matching API facilitates the verification and reconciliation of trade confirmations between parties to ensure accuracy and agreement on trade details. This API enables financial institutions and trading entities to efficiently confirm trades, minimizing discrepancies and enhancing operational efficiency in trade processing. Typical users include traders, risk managers, and compliance officers who require reliable confirmation data for audit and reporting purposes. By leveraging this API, organizations can streamline their market operations and improve overall trade accuracy.

get.description: This endpoint allows users to retrieve details related to trade confirmation matching operations, providing insights into the status and results of trade confirmations within the market operations.

requestBody.description: This request body is designed to match trade confirmations and must adhere to the specified schema. Ensure that the required fields are provided to facilitate accurate matching of trade confirmations.
